concepts.def: Combination of fuels in supply; UK 2023: gas 40%, renewables 25%, nuclear 15%, others; varies by country.
Pre-2022 Russia supplied 40% of EU gas; Nord Stream pipelines; invasion of Ukraine triggered diversification.
Organisation of Petroleum Exporting Countries (1960) plus Russia from 2016; controls 50% of world oil; cartel sets production.
US emergency oil stockpile created after 1973 oil shock; 700 million barrels capacity; released to ease prices.
Routes from source to user; can be diversified for security; LNG terminals reduce pipeline dependence.
UK new nuclear at £33 billion; 3.2 GW capacity; EDF and CGN financing; security and decarbonisation tensions.
